question.html:
Monochromatic light is incident on two slits and forms an interference pattern on a screen. The diagram shows the intensity of the pattern on the screen.

The separation of the slits is mm and the distance between the slits and the screen is m.

a. Explain why intensity is zero at P.

   [2]

The distance between the central maximum and P is mm.

b. Calculate the wavelength of the incident light.

   [2]

c. State two changes to the intensity pattern when two slits are replaced by ten slits.

   [2]
